title: CoRP is closed under polynomial-time reductions
statement: Let $L$ and $L'$ be languages of bit strings, and suppose $L'$ is polynomial-time many-one reducible to $L$. If $L$ has a coRP verifier in the polynomial-time verifier model, then $L'$ also has a coRP verifier in that model.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ has a coRP verifier in the polynomial-time verifier model
